title: Pharmacometrics
summary: Quantitative pharmacology workflows: population modelling, exposure-response, mechanistic and systems models, and the statistics and data standards they rest on. Co-equal with clinical pharmacology in ambition and in the public roadmap. Depth is being built; the count below is what exists, not what is planned.

target_membership.note: Band A / Quantitative pharmacology holds 16 job-model rows; 15 are skills and one (AI/ML methods in drug development) is a shared reference. Measured membership is the skills array length in this file (regenerate; was 16 on 2026-08-11). Zero released. Most members still carry evidence_gap until R19 domain authoring closes.
